nodes.speaker: Talen
nodes.text: These ruins once guarded the Ember Sanctum. Their doors still answer old switches—and their sentries answer nothing.

nodes.speaker: Talen
nodes.text: What would you like to ask?

nodes.speaker: Talen
nodes.text: Old paths remember patient feet. Look above the obvious road, and listen when the embers hum.

nodes.speaker: Talen
nodes.text: May your next step find solid ground.
